messages:
sven: Heads up — forecasting a 3-4x embed/rerank surge for the Nov holiday quarter. Need a pragmatic multi-region capacity plan and cost envelope. Separate realtime vs batch pools? numbers please.

marta: +1 separate pools. Rerank needs low p99; batch backfills can run on spot/short-lived nodes.

arjun: Quick projection (very rough): baseline embed throughput ~150k req/day -> surge ~600k/day. Rerank baseline ~40k/day -> ~160k/day at peak. Rough GPU hours: realtime ~220 GPU-hrs/day, batch backfill ~480 GPU-hrs/day if compressed into a 6–8h window.

kelly: can you share assumptions for those calcs? batch window, batch size, model variants?

arjun: assumptions: embed model = m1-embed-2 (8-bit quant), avg seq len 128, embedding batch size = 2048, backfill window = 6h; rerank = m2-rank-medium, SLO p99 <=150ms, realtime batching avg 8. cache hit ignored in baseline.

sven: Multi-region split assumption: NA 60%, EU 30%, APAC 10%. Prefer regional dedicated realtime pools (to avoid cross-region p99 penalties) + regional spot burst for batch.

marta: note on networking: cross-region fallback will add egress + latency. Avoid routing rerank across continents for p99-sensitive traffic. Fallbacks should be same-continent only.

infra-oncall: Scheduled maintenance in eu-west on 1778050000 - 1778053600 (expected capacity -8 GPUs).

kelly: cost check: if realtime is reserved capacity, naive realtime GPUs needed at peak ~ NA 12 GPUs, EU 6 GPUs, APAC 2 GPUs (this includes ~25% headroom). Batch can be 20-30 spot GPUs per region during backfill windows.

arjun: propose concretely: NA realtime dedicated pool = 12 GPUs; EU realtime = 6 GPUs; APAC realtime = 2 GPUs. Batch jobs run on spot burst pools, backfill at 02:00 local with 25% headroom.

sven: ok what's that translate to for monthly GPU-hours and $, ballpark?

kelly: rough math: realtime monthly = (12+6+2) * 24 * 30 = 14,400 GPU-hrs/month. Batch spot ~ 180 GPU-hrs/day * 30 = 5,400 GPU-hrs/month. Total ~19,800 GPU-hrs/month. At reserved $2/hr ~= $39.6k/mo. With spot + discounts ~ $25k-$32k/mo. Need Finance to confirm rates.

marta: optimization ideas: enable 8-bit quant for rerank where accuracy allows (estimate ~15-20% GPU reduction), enable KV/prefix caching for embeddings to cut duplicate token work (10-15% benefit).

arjun: operational asks: autoscale policy tweaks (scale on p95 latency + queue depth), cooldowns to avoid flapping, and pre-warm 2 nodes ~30min before predicted surge windows. Also add canary traffic to new capacity for 10m before flipping live.

sven: @kelly can you put these variants (reserved vs spot vs mixed, quant vs full precision) into the forecasting sheet and include egress cost per TB for potential cross-region fallbacks?

kelly: on it — will upload a sheet + cost scenarios by EOD. If anyone has historical Q4 traffic or 2024 holiday spike data, ping me and I'll fold it in.

aria-bot: Alert: queue depth spiked 3x in us-west at 1778005200; autoscaler added +2 GPUs automatically.

sven: great catch. If autoscaler is tripping repeatedly we should raise cooldown or use step-scaling to avoid oscillation.

arjun: also consider a prioritized SLA pool for top customers — route them to a small dedicated set so business-critical rerank doesn't compete with free-tier batch. Product sign-off required.

sven: Action items: @kelly — forecast sheet + cost variants; @marta — region fallback policy doc + egress calc; @arjun — autoscale + pre-warm runbook; reconvene tomorrow 10:00am PT to finalize numbers. :thumbsup:

kelly: will do.

marta: noted.

arjun: adding runbook items to the infra repo after sync.

sven: thanks all — good first pass.
